description:
FILED s1061 (Opus, 2026-09-07) from #1061's CPAN-board bisects.  Both rows
moved DOWN in STATUS (PASS -> PARTIAL) by running FURTHER than they used to:
neither is a regression in rows, both are honest failures a fix exposed.  Row
level belongs to #1502; the reproducers and first causes are here.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------
A. Algorithm-Diff t/oo.t   PASS 59/0  ->  PARTIAL 102/20   (perl: 969/0)
   bisected to `b1847eb7` (s411d, Phase A4 -- ONE DIALECT: generate/gen_node
   print the form generator, the text emitters deleted, the decline sites die).
   Intermediate readings on the way: 100/2 at `49b9cedb` (s414g),
   102/20 at `cf0076c7` (s438f) -- so a SECOND transition, 2 -> 20 failing
   rows, sits between s414 and s438 and is not bisected here.

   The failures are the object interface's hunk iteration.  First one:

     not ok 61   got: ""      expected: "b"
     not ok 67   got: "b c"   expected: "b"
     not ok 72   got: ""      expected: "b"
     not ok 73   got: "d"     expected: "c"

   i.e. `join(' ', $d->Items(1))` / `$d->Items(2)` after `$d->Next()` --
   PCL walks the hunk list differently.  Then the file DIES at row 122 of 969
   with Algorithm::Diff's own croak leaking out of an eval:

     Algorithm::Diff, Get: Invalid request (min1)

   which the test wraps in `ok( ! eval { $d->Get('Min1'); 1 } )`, so the
   escape itself is the second thing to look at.

   Run it with:  tools/run-dist-t.pl ~/.cpan/build/Algorithm-Diff-1.201-0 t/oo.t

--------------------------------------------------------------------------
B. Data-Dump t/dump.t      PASS 31/0  ->  PARTIAL 34/2     (perl: 38/0)
   bisected to `a46aa3f0` (s404f, #354 + #351: two PPI operator-vs-term
   mis-lexes that ate whole statements, repaired on the token stream).  Three
   more rows run because three more statements survive.

   Both failures are ONE divergence -- a blessed reference to a SCALAR marks
   the REFERENT blessed, not the reference (dump.t:57-58):

     my $sv = [];
     dump(bless \$sv, "foo")
        perl:  bless(do{\(my $o = [])}, "foo")
        PCL:   bless(do{\(my $o = bless([, "foo"))}, "foo")

   -- the inner `[]` comes back blessed into "foo" as well.  Same shape in the
   row after it, inside a hash.  Family: docs/xs-blessed-ref-referent-bug.md /
   ir-spec's ref model.

   The file then DIES two rows short of its plan on

     dump({ a => \&Data::Dump::dump, aa => do { require Symbol; Symbol::gensym() } })

   with a simple-type-error -- `(sb-impl::gethash3 k h nil)` where h is not a
   hash table, i.e. Symbol::gensym()'s return value reaching a hash read.


=== DONE half A (s523a, Opus 5.5, 2026-10-20) -- THREE mechanisms, each one small and in its own layer; half B (Data-Dump) stays #1573's ===
(1) RANGE vs FLIP-FLOP in an inherited context (Pl/ExprToCL.pm gen_binary_op_form): a `..` whose context is INHERITED (a sub's return / tail, a ternary arm under it) was forced to the FLIP-FLOP when its operands were not literals; perl's pp_flip asks GIMME at run time.  Algorithm::Diff's `Range` (`return ($b + $idx[$lo]) .. ($b + $idx[$hi] - 1)`) answered "1E0" in list context (Fable's c5 finding).  Now an inherited `..` always emits the run-time choice `(if (eq *wantarray* t) (p-.. L R) (FLIPFLOP id L R))`, the flip-flop flavour chosen as in scalar context (num / dyn / boolean).  Probes scratch/s523a/pr/rg.pl (7 shapes: return paren / plain / implicit tail / slice / wantarray ternary / count / via array) + ff.pl (11: grep / map / statement-modifier flip-flops, sub tail in scalar and list, anon sub, do, count, join) -- perl = tree; base wrong on 6 + 4.
(2) `X || not $v = E` (Pl/PExpr.pm, the low-precedence `not` deadlock rule): the rule reduced `not` over ONE term assuming its operand was already reduced, which is false when the operand holds an operator LOOSER than the binary op (`=`, `?:`): `0 || not $k = $h{min}` became `(0 || not $k) = $h{min}`; `1 && not $y = 0` was a DROPPED statement ("Can't modify non-lvalue subroutine call").  Now `not`'s operand (everything to the next and/or/xor) is collapsed into one term first.  Algorithm::Diff's `Get` (`... || not $meth = $getName{ lc $2 }`) died "Invalid request (min1)" -- that was oo.t row 122's "escape", not an eval bug (eval { croak } is caught, Fable's c5).  Probe nt.pl (10 shapes incl. `$x = not 5`, `my @a = not 0`, `not $a == $b`, ternary, `and`, `+`, list) -- perl = tree.
(3) PPI §38's code-sigil twin (Pl/Parser.pm _repair_statement_start_glob_cast widened to `&`): after `{ 1 while $x; }` PPI lexes the `&` of `&$cb(...)` as bitwise AND -> `(p-bit-and ARGS $cb)`, the call silently skipped.  traverse_sequences' trailing `&$discardACallback(...) if ...` after an if block ending in a `while` modifier -> base.t rows 6/10/15 (`a h` for `a h n p`).  Logged: docs/ppi-upstream-bugs.md §38 addendum, docs/ppi-bug-report.t row 91, canary Pl/t/misc-fixes-02.t row 142.  Probe am2.pl / am6.pl.
GUARDS: Pl/t/regex-pos-01.t rows 46-77; base.t 35/0 confirmed before the rebase (the four probes; 1-, 2-, 3- shapes FAIL on 8038fac6).
ACCEPTANCE: Algorithm-Diff oo.t 102/20 of 122 -> 969/0 (perl 969), base.t 32/3 -> 35/0 (re-run after the rebase); all 23 blessed rows + the *PLAN* row left baselines/cpan-board14-fails.tsv by edit.
subject: Two CPAN-board files that now run MORE rows and fail honestly: Algorithm-Diff oo.t (59/0 -> 102/20, the hunk iterator answers the wrong items and then dies) and Data-Dump dump.t (31/0 -> 34/2, a blessed SCALAR ref marks the REFERENT blessed, then Symbol::gensym crashes)
